apiKey.description: ImageSearchPlugin.spec.apiKey[str]: the name of the Smarter Secret that contains a Brave Search API key. The api key itself is never included in the manifest.
apiKey.title: Apikey

cacheTtl.description: ImageSearchPlugin.spec.cacheTtl[int]: seconds to cache search results. 0 disables caching.
cacheTtl.title: Cachettl

filters.description: ImageSearchPlugin.spec.filters[obj]: the filters that Smarter applies to the search results.

llmSearchParams.description: ImageSearchPlugin.spec.llmSearchParams[bool]: whether the LLM may set every Brave Image Search API parameter in each tool call: count (up to 20), country, search_lang, safesearch and spellcheck. searchParams are then the defaults. If false, the LLM may only lower the count.
llmSearchParams.title: Llmsearchparams

queryTerms.description: ImageSearchPlugin.spec.queryTerms[str]: optional search terms appended to every query that the LLM sends, e.g. 'black and white photograph'. The LLM always supplies the query itself, e.g. 'formula 1 race cars', so that Brave searches for 'formula 1 race cars black and white photograph'.
queryTerms.title: Queryterms

searchParams.description: ImageSearchPlugin.spec.searchParams[obj]: the Brave Image Search API query parameters.

timeout.description: ImageSearchPlugin.spec.timeout[int]: seconds to wait for each web request, 1 to 60.
timeout.title: Timeout

validateUrls.description: ImageSearchPlugin.spec.validateUrls[bool]: only return image urls that respond to a request with HTTP 200, and not with a web page. Urls are always https.
validateUrls.title: Validateurls

ImageSearchFilters.description:
Smarter API - ImageSearchPlugin.spec.imageSearchData.filters.

Smarter applies these to the Brave Image Search API's results.

allowedDomains.description: ImageSearchPlugin.spec.filters.allowedDomains[list]: if not empty, only images from web pages on these domains, and their subdomains.
allowedDomains.title: Alloweddomains

blockedDomains.description: ImageSearchPlugin.spec.filters.blockedDomains[list]: never images on these domains, nor from web pages on them, including their subdomains.
blockedDomains.title: Blockeddomains

fileType.description: ImageSearchPlugin.spec.filters.fileType[str]: only images of these file types, separated by '|', e.g. jpg|png. Any of: ['jpg', 'png', 'gif', 'svg', 'webp', 'avif', 'bmp', 'ico']
fileType.title: Filetype

minHeight.description: ImageSearchPlugin.spec.filters.minHeight[int]: only images at least this many pixels high. Images whose height Brave does not report are skipped.
minHeight.title: Minheight

minWidth.description: ImageSearchPlugin.spec.filters.minWidth[int]: only images at least this many pixels wide. Images whose width Brave does not report are skipped.
minWidth.title: Minwidth

ImageSearchFilters.title: ImageSearchFilters

ImageSearchParams.description:
Smarter API - ImageSearchPlugin.spec.imageSearchData.searchParams.

These map 1:1 to the query parameters of the Brave Image Search API, except for ``q``, the
query itself, which the LLM supplies. See ``imageSearchData.queryTerms``.

count.description: ImageSearchPlugin.spec.searchParams.count[int]: the maximum number of images per search, 1 to 20.
count.title: Count

country.description: ImageSearchPlugin.spec.searchParams.country[str]: a two letter country code, e.g. us, or all for worldwide results.
country.title: Country

searchLang.description: ImageSearchPlugin.spec.searchParams.searchLang[str]: prefer images from content in this language, e.g. en or pt-br.
searchLang.title: Searchlang

spellcheck.description: ImageSearchPlugin.spec.searchParams.spellcheck[bool]: whether Brave may correct the spelling of the query.
spellcheck.title: Spellcheck

ImageSearchParams.title: ImageSearchParams

maxTokens.title: Maxtokens

model.description: Plugin.spec.prompt.model[str] Optional. The model of the Plugin. Defaults to gpt-6-luna. Must be one of: ['chat-latest', 'gpt-4.1', 'gpt-4.1-2025-04-14', 'gpt-4.1-mini', 'gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14', 'gpt-4o', 'gpt-4o-2024-08-06', 'gpt-4o-2024-11-20', 'gpt-4o-mini', 'gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18', 'gpt-5-search-api', 'gpt-5-search-api-2025-10-14', 'gpt-5.2', 'gpt-5.2-2025-12-11', 'gpt-5.4', 'gpt-5.4-2026-03-05', 'gpt-5.4-mini', 'gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17', 'gpt-5.5', 'gpt-5.5-2026-04-23', 'gpt-5.6-luna', 'gpt-5.6-sol', 'gpt-5.6-terra', 'gpt-6-astra', 'gpt-6-luna', 'gpt-6-sol', 'gpt-6.1-sol']

provider.description: Plugin.spec.prompt.provider[str]. Optional. The provider of the LLM. Defaults to openai. The provider is the vendor name for the LLM service that will be used to generate the prompt response.
provider.title: Provider

systemRole.description: Plugin.spec.prompt.systemRole[str]. Required. The system role that the Plugin will use for the LLM text completion prompt. Be verbose and specific. Ensure that systemRole accurately conveys to the LLM how you want it to use the Plugin data that is returned. The maximum length is 32768 characters.
systemRole.title: Systemrole

temperature.description: Plugin.spec.prompt.temperature[float] Optional. The temperature of the Plugin. Defaults to 1.0. Should be between 0 and 1.0. The higher the temperature, the more creative the response. The lower the temperature, the more predictable the response.
temperature.title: Temperature
